items.q: Does using longer words always improve writing?
items.correct: No — clear, precise words suited to purpose and audience matter more.
items.misconception: Yes, the longer the words the better.
items.why: Effective writing matches vocabulary and variety to purpose.
Apostrophes mark ownership or missing letters — not plurals.

items.correct: Examining how language and structure achieve the writer's purpose.
items.why: Analysis explains the effect of word choice, tone and structure.
